# AgentFit

> A local-first decision instrument. It scores a workflow on economic opportunity,
> technical readiness, controllability and risk, and recommends how much autonomy
> that workflow has earned, before anyone writes an orchestration graph.

Everything runs in the browser. Assessments are stored on the device; there is no
account, no telemetry and no network call.

## What it produces

- A fit score out of 100, and the confidence that comes from how many of the 20
  dimensions have been reviewed rather than left at a preset.
- A recommended autonomy rung, from human-led process through assistive agent to
  bounded autonomy, with the reason it stopped there.
- A brief you can share as a link, which carries the assessment in the fragment and
  therefore never reaches a server.

## Pages

- [The instrument](https://agent-fit2.vercel.app/)
- [Method](https://agent-fit2.vercel.app/#/method): what each dimension means and how it is weighted.
